name: DocRaptor
description: Integrates the DocRaptor HTML-to-PDF SaaS API (Prince-based) so code can turn HTML into a PDF (or other document type) via a service class.
project_description: DocRaptor integrates the DocRaptor HTML-to-PDF SaaS API, which renders documents with the commercial Prince engine, into Drupal 10.2+/11. The module ships one service (docraptor.manager / DocraptorManager) that wraps the docraptor/docraptor PHP SDK: given a block of HTML and a filename it builds a DocRaptor Doc, applies the site's configured Prince options (document type, PDF profile, colour conversion, PDF forms, ICC profile, test mode) and writes the returned bytes to a file. The DocRaptor account credential (used as the API basic-auth username) is not stored in plain config; it is supplied through a Key entity selected on the settings form. The module provides only a settings form and this service, leaving it to custom code to call the service and decide what HTML to render and where to store the result. Note the module is a community contribution and is not officially supported by DocRaptor.
